authority: Reviewable test expectations, not an independent human audit or a live-model quality measurement.

cases.reason: A well-sourced plateau is useful evidence of a persistent constraint; novelty is not required.
The same metric has a later accepted comparable record; a human must release the pin.
The incumbent has accepted spaced checkpoints; use a truthful chart without replacing the measure.
The fixture contrasts installed nominal units with usable operating units. A direct comparison clears the same-profile heuristic margin; it still needs human adjudication.
A changed measurement method interrupts the incumbent's comparable evidence. The proposed demotion is surfaced for human adjudication.
Sparse evidence supports abstention, not an inferred inflection or invented history.
An unsupported forecast cannot replace a historical indicator regardless of its dramatic curve.
A quantity in model prose without structured exact evidence is rejected.
